name: Huevos rancheros
steps: Warm the tinned tomatoes in a pan with a pinch of salt to make a quick salsa.
Heat the black beans through in a small pan.
Fry the eggs in the olive oil to your liking.
Warm the corn tortillas in the dry pan until soft.
Layer the tortillas with beans, then slide the eggs on top.
Spoon over the tomato salsa and scatter with the cheese.
